sql.value: select b.id, b.name, b.scope_type, b.scope_id, b.period, b.amount, b.alert_threshold, b.enable_status, b.remark, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time from ai_budget b where b.is_deleted = 0 #[and b.name like concat('%', :name, '%')] #[and b.scope_type = :scopeType] #[and b.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by b.id desc
select coalesce(sum(cost), 0) as used_cost from ai_audit_log where create_time >= :startTime #[and model_id = :modelId] #[and user_id = :userId]
